description: Header file defining the ConnectorType class and ConnectorController singleton for RPC communication in the Thunder namespace, including external server proxies and thread-unsafe controller management.

classes.name: ConnectorController
classes.description: Singleton class managing a Core::IUnknown controller, not thread-safe, with methods to announce, revoke, and access the controller.

classes.name: ConnectorType
classes.description: Template class managing communication channels via RPC, with nested Channel class for connection handling, acquire methods, and operational status management.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of ConnectorController.

methods.name: Announce
methods.description: Sets and references a controller object.

methods.name: Revoke
methods.description: Releases and clears the controller object.

methods.name: Controller
methods.description: Returns the current controller with an added reference.

methods.name: Acquire
methods.description: Creates and returns an interface pointer for a remote node.

methods.name: Communicator
methods.description: Returns a proxy to the CommunicatorClient for a given node.

methods.name: Engine
methods.description: Returns a reference to the RPC engine server.

methods.name: Operational
methods.description: Virtual method to set operational status, meant to be overridden.
